resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Rex's page and Willhite give 1933 for the L-4 cab after a 1930 camp; nwhiker.com says the lookout was built in 1932. The story reports both.
The register says removed in 1966 and Rex's page and Willhite say destroyed in 1966. Same year, different word; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Core facts (camp 1930, cab 1933, removed or destroyed 1966, lookout gone) agree across the main pages. Build year 1932 (nwhiker.com) is the outlier. Brief calls the site kind ground; the pages describe an L-4 cab and Willhite also calls it a lookout tower, so kind was left alone. The brief's lat/lon matches the register's coordinates (N 46 42.371, W 121 39.879), seen in a search snippet, not a read page. Unread lead: a Forest Fire Lookout Association post (search snippet only) says Hardy's book was first published in 1980, which conflicts with Willhite's Macmillan 1946 date; not read, not used. Alpine Lily's visit date is not stated, so the road and summit observations are undated. No photos added: no image URLs or licenses were read.
